cases.title: Photographs in the catalog
cases.description: A visitor opens the catalog and sees a photograph on each piece that has one.

cases.title: Complete piece fiche
cases.description: A piece page shows title, artist, certificate state, and the attached photographs or documents.

cases.title: Valid certificate lists its signers
cases.description: Public verification of a finalized certificate lists the signers: one for a living author, two for a deceased author.

cases.title: Uncertified piece is marked
cases.description: A piece that has not been finalized is marked as not certified.

cases.title: Catalog filters
cases.description: Filters for certification, sale modality, and participation type narrow the list and can be cleared.
cases.reason: Future sale filter still includes whole-work listings

cases.title: Visitor has no action buttons
cases.description: Without a connected wallet, a visitor can browse and verify, and does not see certify, list, or buy actions.

cases.title: Terms document downloads
cases.description: The participation terms document linked from an offer can be downloaded.

cases.title: Register a fiche with photographs
cases.description: An artist creates a piece fiche and attaches photographs.
cases.reason: register form still omits dimensions, weight, description, and documents

cases.title: Living author, fee in XLM
cases.description: The living author signs once and pays the certification fee in XLM (5 XLM). The certificate finalizes.

cases.title: Museum authorizes a connoisseur
cases.description: For a deceased author, a museum authorizes the connoisseur who will sign.

cases.title: Connoisseur signs, second signature pending
cases.description: The connoisseur signs. The certificate stays pending until the second signature.

cases.title: Museum second signature finalizes
cases.description: The museum adds the second signature. The certificate becomes valid.

cases.title: Second signature on a pending demo piece
cases.description: A demo piece left pending receives its second signature and becomes valid.

cases.title: Digitize a prior certificate
cases.description: An existing certificate is digitized. The fiche stores the document hash and the certification flow records it.
cases.reason: prior digitization rejects PDF and leaves an orphan fiche

cases.title: Verify C-02, C-05, and C-07
cases.description: The public verify page, including the QR link, shows the certificates from C-02, C-05, and C-07 as valid.

cases.title: List a whole digital work in XLM
cases.description: The owner lists the whole work as a digital sale priced in XLM.

cases.title: Buy the whole work
cases.description: A second account buys the whole work. Ownership moves to the buyer.

cases.title: Resale with three owners
cases.description: The work is sold again. The ownership history shows three owners.
cases.reason: not exercised on re-test; whole-work buy path cleared (S-02)

cases.title: List with physical delivery
cases.description: The owner lists a whole work with a physical-delivery clause.

cases.title: Buy in USDC and send the delivery form
cases.description: A buyer pays in USDC and submits the physical-delivery form. Delivery itself stays off-chain.

cases.title: Museum offers each participation type
cases.description: A museum publishes one offer of each type — future sale, guaranteed repurchase, financing with return, and exploitation rights — each with a terms document.

cases.title: Buy an entire primary offer
cases.description: A buyer takes every unit of a primary offer in one payment.

cases.title: Buy part of a primary offer
cases.description: A buyer takes some of the units. The remainder stays available.

cases.title: List on the secondary market
cases.description: A holder lists units they already hold.

cases.title: Partial secondary purchase
cases.description: Another buyer takes part of that secondary listing.

cases.title: Cancel the remainder
cases.description: The seller cancels what is left of the listing. The remaining units return to the seller.

cases.title: Run distribution
cases.description: Distribution runs for an offer under its published terms.

cases.title: Buy the cheap demo offer
cases.description: A buyer purchases the low-priced public demo offer used as the Try it path (Estudio en azul).

cases.title: Buy without a wallet
cases.description: Choosing buy with no wallet does not submit a transaction. The page asks for Freighter.

cases.title: A collector cannot certify
cases.description: A collector session does not offer a certify action.

cases.title: One signature is not enough
cases.description: A deceased-author certificate with only one signature stays incomplete, and the page says so.

cases.title: More units than available
cases.description: Asking for more units than the offer has left is refused, with a clear message, and nothing is transferred.

cases.title: Insufficient balance
cases.description: A buy with too little XLM or USDC is refused, with a clear message.

cases.title: Unknown certificate
cases.description: A verify link for a certificate that does not exist is a not-found page.

cases.title: Ops routes are closed
cases.description: Operational endpoints do not respond to an anonymous caller.
